INSERT INTO production_orders_dv (data)
    SELECT JSON(
      '{
        "_id": 900001,
        "customerSiteId": 1,
        "plantId": 1,
        "scheduledStart": "2026-09-22",
        "dueDate": "2026-09-24",
        "status": "planned",
        "total": 250.00,
        "setupCost": 0,
        "items": [
          {
            "orderLineId": 990001,
            "componentId": 1,
            "quantity": 2,
            "unitCost": 125.00
          }
        ]
      }'
    )
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM production_orders
      WHERE production_order_id = 900001
    )
